rule: Higher estimated external rotational symmetry number (sigma) raises melting point.
rdkit_hint: Estimate sigma from graph automorphisms: count distinct canonical atom ranks via Chem.CanonicalRankAtoms(mol, breakTies=False); proxy = n_heavy / n_unique_ranks; also count automorphisms with mol.GetSubstructMatches(mol, uniquify=False).
메모: 3D 외부 회전 대칭수 대신 2D 그래프 자기동형 수(상한 대리)와 원자 등가류 비

rule: Use log(sigma) rather than raw sigma as the feature, since its effect on Tm is logarithmic.
rdkit_hint: log(len(mol.GetSubstructMatches(mol, uniquify=False, useChirality=False))) on the heavy-atom graph.

rule: Higher Yalkowsky flexibility number phi = 2.435^(tau), with tau = SP3 + 0.5*SP2 + 0.5*RING - 1 for non-terminal chain atoms, lowers melting point.
rdkit_hint: Count non-ring, non-terminal heavy atoms by hybridization: SP3 = [CX4;!R;!D1], SP2 = [CX3,NX2;!R;!D1]=*; RING = number of fused ring systems; tau = SP3 + 0.5*SP2 + 0.5*RING - 1, floored at 0.
메모: RING=고리계(접합 병합) 수; ΔSm=50−R ln σ + R ln φ(σ는 자기동형 수 대리)

rule: Para-disubstituted benzenes melt higher than their ortho and meta isomers.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [!#1;!c]c1ccc([!#1;!c])cc1 on a ring with exactly two substituents.
메모: 고립 벤젠 고리만

rule: Meta-disubstituted benzenes typically have the lowest Tm among the three regioisomers.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [!#1;!c]c1cccc([!#1;!c])c1 with ring substituent count == 2.
메모: 고립 벤젠 고리만

rule: Ortho-disubstituted benzenes usually melt lower than para isomers, except when the substituents form an intramolecular H-bond, which lowers Tm further.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [!#1;!c]c1c([!#1;!c])cccc1 with ring substituent count == 2.
메모: 고립 벤젠 고리만; 분자내 수소결합 예외는 hb_intra로 따로

rule: 1,3,5-trisubstituted, 1,2,4,5-tetrasubstituted, and hexasubstituted benzenes with identical substituents melt anomalously high.
rdkit_hint: Benzene ring with substituents at positions matching c1c(X)cc(X)cc1X, and identical canonical ranks for the substituent atoms.

rule: An intramolecular 6-membered H-bond (e.g., ortho-hydroxy carbonyl, ortho-nitrophenol, salicylate) lowers Tm relative to the isomer that can only H-bond intermolecularly.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [OX2H,NX3H1,NX3H2]-c:c-[CX3]=O, [OX2H]-c:c-[N+](=O)[O-], [OX2H]-c:c-C=N; also [OH]-C-C=C-C=O enol.
메모: SMARTS 4종(오르토 OH/NH–카보닐·니트로·이민, 엔올)

rule: The number of H-bond donors not engaged in a recognized intramolecular H-bond raises melting point.
rdkit_hint: NumHDonors minus the count of intramolecular_hbond matches.

rule: Secondary amides (N-H plus C=O) raise Tm strongly through infinite chain (C(4)) H-bonding.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [CX3](=O)[NX3H1][#6].

rule: Primary amides raise Tm even more than secondary amides because they form 2D H-bonded sheets.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [CX3](=O)[NX3H2].

rule: N,N-disubstituted amides melt far lower than primary or secondary amides of similar size.
Ureas, especially N,N'-disubstituted or unsubstituted ones, raise Tm markedly.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [NX3H1,NX3H2]C(=O)[NX3H1,NX3H2].

rule: Cyclic imides and lactams with N-H (succinimide, hydantoin, barbiturate, uracil) raise Tm.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [#6;R](=O)[NX3H1;R][#6;R](=O) and [NX3H1;R]C(=O)[NX3;R].

rule: Carboxylic acids raise Tm through cyclic R2,2(8) dimers, with diacids raising it much more.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [CX3](=O)[OX2H1]; use count >= 2 as a separate feature.

rule: Molecules that can exist as zwitterions (amino acids, aminosulfonic acids, betaines) have very high Tm, often with decomposition.
rdkit_hint: Formal charges present with net zero charge, or a basic amine plus an acid: [NX3;H2,H1;!$(NC=O);!$(Na)] and [CX3](=O)[OX2H1] or S(=O)(=O)[OH] in the same molecule.
메모: 형식 전하 순합 0(니트로 제외) 또는 산+염기성 아민 동시 존재로 근사; pKa 미고려

rule: Explicit salts with multiple fragments and formal charges raise Tm sharply.
rdkit_hint: len(Chem.GetMolFrags(mol)) > 1 and any atom.GetFormalCharge() != 0.
메모: 데이터에 해당 분자 0개(열 전부 0)

rule: A higher fraction of heavy atoms in a conjugated sp2/aromatic planar system raises Tm.
rdkit_hint: Count of atoms with SP2 or aromatic hybridization in the largest conjugated system (Chem.ResonanceMolSupplier, or a BFS over conjugated bonds) divided by the heavy atom count.
메모: 공명 구조 대신 RDKit GetIsConjugated 결합 연결 성분

rule: Larger linear or peri-fused aromatic ring systems raise Tm.
rdkit_hint: Size of the largest fused aromatic ring system, computed by merging aromatic rings from RingInfo that share bonds.
메모: 선형/페리 접합 구분은 안 함

rule: Biaryls with ortho substituents next to the inter-ring bond melt lower than unhindered biaryls.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [!#1;!c]c:c-c:c and specifically c(-[!#1])(:c)-c(:c)-[!#1] across a biaryl bond (c-c, non-ring bond).

rule: Trans (E) double bonds raise Tm relative to cis (Z), and cis unsaturation in long chains strongly depresses Tm.
rdkit_hint: Count bonds with BondStereo STEREOE vs STEREOZ on C=C; SMARTS C/C=C/C vs C/C=C\C.
메모: SMILES에 표기된 E/Z만; 긴 사슬 시스 불포화 상호작용항 없음

rule: In homologous n-alkyl series (alkanes, acids, diacids, diols), even-carbon chains melt higher than adjacent odd-carbon chains.
rdkit_hint: Length L of the longest unbranched CH2 chain ending in a terminal group; feature = (L mod 2 == 0) interacted with a terminal functional group flag.
메모: 말단 작용기 종류 대신 수소결합 주개 유무와 곱

rule: Tm increases with linear alkyl chain length but asymptotically saturates (convergence toward polyethylene at about 414 K).
rdkit_hint: Longest path of [CH2X4] atoms (SMARTS [CH2X4]-[CH2X4] chained); feature = L/(L+c) or 1/L.

rule: Branching near the end of a chain (iso- or 2-methyl) lowers Tm relative to the linear isomer, while highly compact globular branching (tert-butyl, neopentyl-like cores) raises it.
rdkit_hint: Count [CH1X4]([CH3])([CH3]) for iso termini (lowers); count [CX4]([CH3])([CH3])([CH3]) and quaternary carbons (raises); ratio of quaternary to tertiary carbons.

rule: Compact, near-spherical cage molecules (adamantane, cubane, camphor, hexamethylethane) have anomalously high Tm.
rdkit_hint: Bridged polycyclic flag: rdMolDescriptors.CalcNumBridgeheadAtoms > 0 combined with a low rotatable fraction; or Wiener index normalized by n^3 (low means compact).

rule: Linear or rod-like molecular shape (high graph diameter relative to atom count) raises Tm compared with bent shapes of the same size.
rdkit_hint: Graph diameter from Chem.GetDistanceMatrix max divided by heavy atom count, restricted to rigid (non-rotatable) path segments.
메모: 강직 구간 제한 없이 그래프 지름/원자 수

rule: Heavy halogens (I, Br) on electron-poor aromatic or sp carbons raise Tm through halogen bonding to N, O, or other halogens.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [I,Br]-c and [I,Br]-[c;$(c:c-[F,Cl,$([N+](=O)[O-]),C#N])] present together with acceptors [n,O=*,N#C].
메모: 전자 부족 탄소 조건 없이 방향족 I/Br × 받개 존재

rule: Perfluorinated or heavily fluorinated alkyl segments lower Tm relative to what their molecular weight would suggest.
rdkit_hint: Fraction of F atoms among heavy atoms; SMARTS C(F)(F)F count.

rule: Molecules containing both an electron-rich arene and a perfluoroarene (or complementary quadrupole rings) raise Tm.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS c1(F)c(F)c(F)c(F)c(F)c1 plus an unfluorinated aromatic ring in the same molecule.

rule: Aromatic nitro groups, especially para to donor groups (push-pull), raise Tm.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS c[N+](=O)[O-]; push-pull: [NX3H2,OH]c1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1.

rule: Aromatic nitriles and dinitriles raise Tm through strong antiparallel dipole interactions.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS cC#N count; para-dicyano c1(C#N)ccc(C#N)cc1.

rule: Aromatic N-H (pyrrole, indole, imidazole, pyrazole, benzimidazole) combined with a ring acceptor raises Tm via catemer or dimer formation.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [nH] count; imidazole/pyrazole [nH]1cncc1, [nH]1nccc1.

rule: Molecules containing both an aromatic N acceptor and an OH/NH donor (e.g., hydroxypyridine/pyridone, aminopyridine) melt high.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [nX2] present together with [OX2H,NX3H2,NX3H1]; pyridone O=c1cccc[nH]1.

rule: Multiple hydroxyl groups (polyols, sugars) raise Tm superlinearly when they are on a rigid scaffold, but less so on flexible chains.
rdkit_hint: Count [OX2H][CX4] multiplied by (1 - fraction of rotatable bonds); ring-attached OH count [OX2H][C;R].

rule: Molecules whose only heteroatom functionality is ester, ether, or ketone (no donors) melt lower than donor-containing analogues of equal size.
rdkit_hint: NumHDonors == 0 and presence of [CX3](=O)[OX2][#6] or [OD2]([#6])[#6] or [#6][CX3](=O)[#6].

rule: Molecules with unspecified stereocenters (racemates or diastereomer mixtures) or many stereocenters tend to have lower or irregular Tm, while meso or C2-symmetric stereo raises it.
rdkit_hint: len(Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol, includeUnassigned=True)) minus the assigned count; meso check via comparing canonical SMILES of the mirror image.
메모: 메소 판정(거울상 canonical SMILES 비교) 미구현

rule: Sulfonamides (especially primary SO2NH2) and sulfones raise Tm strongly.
Rigid conjugated linkers (azo, stilbene, tolane, imine) between aromatic rings raise Tm relative to flexible CH2 or O linkers.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS c/N=N/c, cC=Cc, cC#Cc, cC=Nc vs flexible cCc, cOc, cCCc.

rule: A high fraction of terminal methyl groups relative to heavy atoms (outside compact cages) lowers Tm.
rdkit_hint: Count [CH3X4] divided by heavy atom count, excluding methyls on quaternary carbons in compact cages.
메모: 케이지 4차 탄소 메틸 제외 조건 미적용

rule: Benzene rings carrying exactly two substituents in a para (1,4) relationship raise melting point compared with ortho/meta isomers.
rdkit_hint: Count matches of [c;!$(c[H])]1:[cH]:[cH]:[c;!$(c[H])]:[cH]:[cH]:1 with both non-H substituents; feature = number of para-disubstituted rings
메모: L para_disubstitution과 같은 열

rule: Ortho substitution adjacent to a bridge between two aryl rings, or a bulky ortho group, lowers melting point relative to the para analog.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS c(-[!#1;!c])c([Cl,Br,I,C,O])  restricted to rings attached via [c]-[C,N,O,S]=?-[c]; count of ortho-substituted biaryl/aryl-bridge junctions: [c;$(c[!#1;!c])]:c-[CX3,NX2,O,S]-c
메모: 오르토 치환 + 아릴–다리–아릴 SMARTS 1종으로 근사

rule: An aromatic carboxylic acid group strongly raises melting point.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS c[CX3](=O)[OX2H1]

rule: Aryl boronic acids, B(OH)2, raise melting point strongly.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [BX3]([OX2H])[OX2H]

rule: Aryl hydrazones conjugated to cyclic imide or dicarbonyl systems (Ar-NH-N=C(C=O)) give very high melting points.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS c[NH]N=C(C=O) ; count matches

rule: Cyclic imides, barbiturate-like ureides, and lactams with an N-H flanked by carbonyls raise melting point.
메모: C=S 포함

rule: Primary amides, hydrazides, and sulfonamides (C(=O)NH2, C(=O)NHNH2, S(=O)(=O)NH2/NH) raise melting point beyond what the simple H-bond donor count predicts.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [CX3](=O)[NX3H2] ; [CX3](=O)[NH][NH2] ; [SX4](=O)(=O)[NX3;H1,H2]

rule: Two or more phenolic OH groups on a planar aromatic scaffold raise melting point steeply.
rdkit_hint: count SMARTS c[OX2H]; feature = max(0, n_phenolic_OH - 1)

rule: An aromatic nitro group para or ortho to an amino/NH donor on the same ring raises melting point.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [NX3;H1,H2]c1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1 or [NX3;H1,H2]c:c[N+](=O)[O-]; also include N=O nitroso

rule: Molecules with two identical aryl halves (C2 or mirror symmetric, e.g., Ar-X-Ar with the same substitution) raise melting point.
rdkit_hint: Symmetry score = 1 - (number of unique CanonicalRankAtoms(breakTies=False) classes / heavy atom count)

rule: Higher topological symmetry overall (fewer unique atom classes per heavy atom) raises melting point.
rdkit_hint: len(set(Chem.CanonicalRankAtoms(m, breakTies=False)))/m.GetNumHeavyAtoms()

rule: A large fraction of atoms in unbranched acyclic CH2 chains lowers melting point per unit of molecular size.
rdkit_hint: fraction of heavy atoms matching [CH2X4;!R] ; or count of longest path of [CH2;!R]

rule: Irregularly branched acyclic alkyl groups, such as sec-butyl or isoamyl, lower melting point, whereas compact quaternary/tert-butyl groups partially offset this.
rdkit_hint: count [CH1X4;!R]([CH3])([CH2]) (irregular branches) vs [CX4;!R]([CH3])([CH3])[CH3] (tert-butyl)

rule: Esters, ethers, orthoesters, and phosphite esters without any H-bond donor lower melting point.
rdkit_hint: n_matches([#6][CX3](=O)O[CX4]) + n_matches([CX4]O[CX4]) when NumHDonors==0

rule: Reactive acyl-halide, sulfonyl chloride, and isocyanate groups lower melting point relative to the corresponding acids or amides.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [CX3](=O)[Cl,Br] ; S(=O)(=O)Cl ; N=C=O

rule: Rigid fused polycyclic aliphatic skeletons (steroid/triterpene, four or more fused rings) raise melting point, especially with polar groups attached.
rdkit_hint: count atoms in ≥3 SSSR rings via ring-fusion: number of bonds shared by two rings; feature = n_fused_ring_bonds where both atoms are sp3

rule: A high fraction of sp2/aromatic atoms in a single conjugated planar system raises melting point.
rdkit_hint: largest conjugated system size: count atoms in largest connected component of bonds with GetIsConjugated(); normalize by heavy atoms
메모: L planarity_fraction과 같은 열

rule: Small monocyclic aromatics carrying only halogen, alkyl, or nitrile substituents and no donors have low-to-moderate melting points that rise with the number of heavy halogens (Br, I).
rdkit_hint: count [Br,I] attached to aromatic atoms: [c][Br,I]
메모: "작은 단환 + 주개 없음" 조건 없이 방향족 Br/I 수

rule: Trifluoromethyl and polyfluoroalkyl groups lower melting point relative to similarly sized substituents.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS C(F)(F)F count

rule: Charged non-nitro species, such as quaternary ammonium, sulfonic acids, or sulfate monoesters, raise melting point.
Thioureas and thioamides with N-H raise melting point.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [NX3;H1,H2]C(=S)

rule: Molecules with two or more secondary amide groups raise melting point beyond additive donor counts.
rdkit_hint: n = count [CX3](=O)[NX3H1]; feature = max(0, n-1)

rule: N,N-dialkyl (tertiary) amides and N-alkylated anilides with ortho-disubstituted aryl groups lower melting point relative to NH analogs.
rdkit_hint: SMARTS [CX3](=O)[NX3H0]([#6])[#6] ; and c1(C)cccc(C)c1N(C)C=O

rule: Diaryl compounds linked by a flexible sp3 or ester/anhydride linker (Ar-CH2-Ar, Ar-C(=O)O-Ar) lower melting point relative to rigid linkers (Ar-N=N-Ar with para substituents, Ar-SO2-Ar, fused rings).
rdkit_hint: SMARTS c[CH2]c ; cC(=O)O[c,C(=O)] ; count rotatable bonds between aromatic ring systems
메모: 방향족 고리계 사이 회전 결합 수는 미구현

rule: Molecules with seven or fewer heavy atoms and no H-bond donors melt very low.
rdkit_hint: HeavyAtomCount<=7 and NumHDonors==0 (binary)
